title: How To Add A New Article

sections.title: 1. Create a file in /public/articles
paragraphs: Add a new .json file in public/articles. You can name it anything, for example: my-first-article.json.
Each file can contain one article object or an array of article objects.

sections.title: 2. Use the required article structure
paragraphs: Every article must have: title, url, and sections.
Each section can contain a title, paragraphs (single string or array), and list (array of strings).

sections.title: 3. Open the article by URL
paragraphs: If article.url does not match the requested slug, the page returns not found.

sections.title: 4. Optional JS format
paragraphs: You can also store content in .js/.mjs/.cjs files.
For JS files, export data as default (or named export: article, articles, or data).
